UEL
@PJL JOB NAME="hello"
@PJL SET RESOLUTION=300
@PJL ENTER LANGUAGE=PCL
ESC E (reset)
ESC &l26A (page size a4)
ESC &l0O (orientation)
ESC &l0L (perforation skip)
ESC &l0E (top margin)
ESC *t300R (raster resolution)
ESC *p0X (cursor x)
ESC *p0Y (cursor y)
ESC *r2338S (raster width)
ESC *b2M (compression mode)
ESC *r1A (start raster graphics)
  raster: 2 rows sent (8 bytes), 100 rows skipped
ESC *rB (end raster graphics)
FF (page 1)
ESC E (reset)
UEL
@PJL EOJ NAME="hello"
UEL
